summary: The RAITProvisioningEditAll user control is part of a web-based enrollment system and handles RAIT provisioning tasks for students. It provides functionalities such as viewing and editing student RAIT details, saving changes, managing user sessions, and configuring display settings.
purpose: To facilitate the management and editing of RAIT provisioning details within the HSPnet enrollment system, allowing for efficient handling of data related to student agency associations and login credentials.

workflows.name: Grid Data Edit Row Command
steps: Check if message exists and errors count.
Iterate over grid rows to identify dirty rows.
Update or add RAIT provisioning using StudentRAITProvisionings.
Redirect if error count is less than 1.

workflows.name: Grid Data Edit Row Data Bound
steps: Handle header visibility based on EnrollmentID.
Bind data to controls like HiddenField, DropDownList, TextBox, CheckBox based on StudentRAITProvisioning object.
Update visibility and states based on read-only state.

workflows.name: Setup JavaScript Variables
steps: Iterate over grid rows to collect dirty field IDs.
Register JavaScript startup script depending on postback status.

business_rules: Hide Save All button if in single Edit mode.
Set row state to Edit if EnrollmentID > -1.
validations: Cancel ObjectDataSource selection if UserSession is null.
conditions: Check if the row type is DataControlRowType.DataRow before data binding.
Execute conditional redirects based on command names in grid commands.
system_behavior: Disable edit fields if blnReadOnly is true.
Hide Save buttons if certain conditions are met (e.g., less than 14 rows).
content_gaps: Incomplete details on calculations and exceptions.
